data.content: For this 360° campaign, with a strong emphasis on digital channels and lead generation, we crafted an experience that mirrored the essence of Dolohot’s flu medicine—healing with a simple swipe. At the heart of the campaign was an interactive webpage where users were invited to engage by "healing" with a swipe, echoing the product’s purpose.

Each swipe brought them closer to a reward, as they were prompted to register for a gift redeemable at their local pharmacies. This seamless interaction not only captivated users but transformed a simple action into a meaningful connection, generating new leads and gathering valuable data. The simplicity of the gesture, combined with the tangible rewards, made this approach both effective and engaging.

Our focus centered on the digital channels, with the biggest share of the budget directed towards social media. By prioritizing these platforms, we tapped into the pulse of online engagement, ensuring our message resonated where our audience spends the most time, maximizing impact and visibility.

We placed significant emphasis on pharmacy displays and branding at key selling points, creating a cohesive and immersive experience. By strategically integrating eye-catching visuals and branded materials in physical spaces, we ensured that Dolohot remained top of mind both online and in-store, reinforcing the campaign’s impact at every customer touchpoint.
